name: @overrun/android
description: Capacitor Android shell for OVERRUN. Ships the built PWA as bundled assets.

scripts.sync: node scripts/configure.mjs && cap sync android && node scripts/inject-native-bridge.mjs
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
